**Research methods:**
- Check Google Maps and Yelp for recent reviews and ratings
- Look at BBB (Better Business Bureau) ratings

- Ask for recommendations in local Pleasanton Facebook groups

**What to compare:**
- Customer reviews and ratings
- Licensing and insurance
- Pricing transparency

**Red flags to avoid:**
- No online reviews or presence
- Unwillingness to provide written estimates
- Pressure to pay in cash upfront
